witness_source.review: Literal integer arrays/constants only; independently enumerate every Unicode scalar via the shipped bitmap representation. Counts and ordered scalar hashes equal the complete FST traversal.

scope: Exact two paths, lengths and hashes. No generic FST, data extension, package or execution waiver.
review: Masked CRC32C, version/type/footer, every contiguous state/packed integer/label/index and backwards edge are verified. No overlaps, opaque tails, forward references, orphan states, nonzero outputs or invalid keys remain. Complete finite traversal yields only four-byte big-endian Unicode scalar numbers and agrees with a separate bitmap encoding.
limitations: This establishes typed inert set data and consistency with the shipped tables, not independent authority for Unicode property correctness or downstream parser safety.
Only the reviewed zero-output FST-v3 set subset is supported.
No Rust source is compiled/evaluated and no third-party FST implementation is executed.
Original binary/table data is not committed; only typed counts, hashes and review evidence are recorded.
